entries.3b004240dee1fc1c: Sports club members (individuals aged 16 and over)
entries.65e96391928ace76: This is a golf driving range that operates 2 stores in Anjō, Aichi Prefecture.
entries.7d304c9b99804c33: These are rental apartments that the company buys or leases land for from landowners, builds and manages, and it owns 51 buildings with 2,040 rooms in Aichi Prefecture. It also leases 3 tenant buildings, including “ＴＯＳＨＯ　ＢＬＤＧ.”
entries.8305791fc4d801eb: The head office is located in Anjō, Aichi Prefecture, and the group consists of the company and 1 consolidated subsidiary (ＡＢ Hotel Co., Ltd.). With “health” as its keyword, the group operates 3 businesses (sports clubs, hotels and real estate), and consolidated employees in the fiscal year ended March 2026 numbered 376. The company is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market and the Nagoya Stock Exchange Premier Market.
entries.b7377fa63e977991: This hotel business is run by the consolidated subsidiary ＡＢ Hotel Co., Ltd., which operates 38 stores, mainly in Aichi Prefecture, under the name “ＡＢ Hotel.” In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥12,274 million, and the number of employees was 103.
entries.e3c15f58116f3642: Hotels with the keyword “More comfortable than business hotels, more reasonable than city hotels” operate 38 stores (15 in Aichi Prefecture and 23 outside Aichi Prefecture) with 4,938 guest rooms.
entries.f9fdf9027a1a7701: This is a membership sports club business, specialized for adults aged 16 and over, that operates 95 stores nationwide under the name “Holiday Sports Club.” In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥12,562 million, and the number of employees was 262.
